propositions: The legacy wordlist was byte-identical to the DSO source at revision 8c5621390668d97e7314c39e06eaab780b504956 and introduced into Rebar verbatim without recording prior corpus or selection methodology.

Immediate provenance from DSO is proven via SHA-256 and Git blob matching across all four examined copies, but antecedent provenance remains unresolved because no primary source documents an upstream corpus.

The DSO repository carried Apache License 2.0 at the final wordlist revision, copied verbatim into Rebar, but this repository-level license does not establish whether a separate corpus-specific license applies.
Coolname and adjective-adjective-animal were examined as candidate sources and disproven via format inspection, SHA-256 mismatch, and absence of three distinctive test words (caulky, outsy, sumpy).
No external repository match was discovered via GitHub code search for the filename or distinctive word combinations, but negative results do not prove originality.
No repository correction is supported by available evidence; adding attribution or corpus-specific licensing terms would overstate the established record.
